dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-m", "lit"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with 'lit' package (commonly used for LLM testing). Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, and sets default command to run lit module. Assumes lit is used for testing Julia language repository components.
